host_boundary: T12 owns typed list_backups and restore_fixture on the existing ipc_invoke union. Both commands require ExplicitRouteArgs (workspace + project) on every call. list_backups lists only BMDock-owned generated fixture backups. restore_fixture copies generated markdown from a named snapshot into a generated BMDock-owned target. Tests observe physical files after restore; the word restored is not disk proof. Production default is EmptyBackupStore: empty catalog is empty state, restore is unsupported. Tests inject FixtureBackupStore over BMDock-owned temp snapshots/targets. T12 does not start rmcp, mix engine profiles, expose callTool or write_note, restore user vaults, scan Obsidian/%APPDATA%/global Basic Memory home, or start/stop Supervisor. Forced-kill, Job Object, sleep-resume, and disk-failure remain UNVERIFIED. A successful fixture restore is not T17/T37/T38 evidence. P0 bmdock-probe and just contract/contract-main stay independent. just build stays the G0 probe. just dev remains the T08 Tauri shell.

AC18.claim: T12 is a fixture restore baseline, not T17/T37/T38. Forced-kill, Job Object/process-tree, sleep-resume, and disk-failure stay UNVERIFIED. AC40.claim: list_backups returns BMDock-owned generated fixture backup ids only. scanned_user_obsidian_vault=false and scanned_user_basic_memory_home=false. files_written is true only after a restore that actually wrote owned files. Empty backups[] is empty state, not a user-vault success. Extra path/root is schema. Non-fixture routes and filesystem backup ids are policy and do not open the store. Restore button is shown only for fixture backup ids. T12 does not scan user Obsidian vaults or global Basic Memory home.

AC52.claim: restore_fixture copies generated markdown from backup id fixture-welcome into a generated owned target. Tests assert target/welcome.md exists and the body matches the snapshot, including Chinese text and a wiki link. classified_as=disk_verified, disk_verified=true, files_written=true, envelope_is_not_disk_proof=true. Envelope-only restored text is accepted_unverified and files_written=false. The command does not restore into %APPDATA%, user Obsidian, or global Basic Memory config. This is not installer, Cloud, or production-vault recovery.

AC53.claim: A restore checklist records what was restored (fixture-welcome / welcome.md), the observed owned temp path pattern, the disk_verified vs accepted_unverified classification, and the UNVERIFIED remainder (forced-kill, Job Object, sleep-resume, disk-failure, T17/T37/T38, user vault). Full user-facing help remains T39.
